lines.text: Gemini 4 Carbon: AA Index v5 #1 at 59 (high); Fairwind cyber-defender preview, not GA
Alphabet: Google Cloud revenue +103% YoY; AI infra and solutions named as major drivers
Nvidia open-weights Nemotron 3.5 Transcribe: 40 languages, ~4.3B active, OpenMDW-1.1

feed.headline: Google announces Gemini 4 Carbon; AA Index v5 #1 at 59 (high)
feed.why: Fairwind cyber-defender preview first. Argon stays live; Google says Carbon builds on Argon, not that it replaces it.

feed.headline: Carbon price: intro $2/$10 then $4/$20; 1M context; text out
feed.why: Same intro path as Argon. AA charts use standard $4/$20. Multimodal input; text output per AA.

feed.headline: Alphabet: Google Cloud revenue grew 103% YoY on AI infra demand
feed.why: Pichai: AI infra and solutions drive Cloud. SEC release: Cloud operating income $11.1B vs $3.6B a year ago; TPU systems a meaningful contributor.

feed.headline: Microsoft: Azure +48%; Microsoft Cloud $63.9B, up 30%
feed.why: Commercial remaining performance obligation up 73% to $677B. Official Q1 FY27 release.

feed.headline: Nvidia ships open-weight Nemotron 3.5 Transcribe (OpenMDW-1.1)
feed.why: ~4.3B active; 40 languages; recordings up to one hour. Nvidia claims best open-weights Open ASR Leaderboard WER; treat as lab until independent recheck.

feed.headline: Report: DeepSeek and Moonshot distilled GPT-6 Astra for latest models
feed.why: The Information via Reuters; OpenAI, DeepSeek, and Moonshot did not immediately comment. Status is reported only.

feed.headline: Report: DOJ inquiring about Nvidia’s ~$12.9B Hugging Face deal
feed.why: Reuters exclusive; CNBC also heard it. DOJ, Nvidia, and Hugging Face have not confirmed. Inquiry is not a finding.

feed.headline: Amazon reports after the close today (call 5:00 PM ET)
feed.why: Cloud and AI spend commentary is the AI tape angle after Alphabet and Microsoft.

feed.headline: DeepSeek starts billing Search and Fetch; Mistral Large 4 weights due by month end
feed.why: Two open-weight calendar markers still in the next few days.

feed.headline: Moonshot: Kimi K3.1 Pro weights by 4 Nov
feed.why: Weights still outstanding after the API/product launch.
